english.title: Publish / cause to be published a prohibited advertisement of a low-welfare animal activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of a business,

(A)_[published in England an advertisement that was]_
(B)_[caused an advertisement to be published in England, it being]_

a prohibited advertisement in that it had the purpose or effect of promoting the observation of, or participation in, an activity which involved an animal, taking place outside the United Kingdom and was of a description specified by activity regulations made by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(2) and 3(1) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) An offence is not committed if the advertisement is contained in a publication (other than an in-flight magazine) which is printed outside the relevant part of the United Kingdom, and whose principal market is not, or does not include, a relevant part of the United Kingdom or any part of one (section 2(5).
(ii) See section 3(6) of the Act for offences committed by bodies corporate.
